Two Assam Women Missing After Being Sent to Bangladesh; MP Seeks External Affairs Minister's Help

Two women from Assam have gone missing after being sent to Bangladesh. Congress MP Gaurav Gogoi has written to External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar seeking his intervention to locate them. The women are reported to have been "illegally pushed back" across the border.
